name: capability-lists
title: The four lists, and a claim about test sensitivity
description: capability-runtime.md has four Tests Required lists and is the safety specification. Its first list contains a claim unlike any this audit has checked: that a granted-but-unregistered check and a granted check are each load-bearing, so removing either must fail a case. That is a claim about test sensitivity, and it can be tested by mutation rather than by search
